name: Strata-NeRF
definition: A single neural radiance field that implicitly captures a scene with multiple levels (stratified scenes) by conditioning the NeRF on Vector Quantized (VQ) latent representations, allowing for sudden changes in scene structure between hierarchical levels.
summary: Strata-NeRF is a neural radiance field method that uses vector quantized latent codes to model stratified scenes with structural discontinuities, avoiding the haziness of standard NeRFs.
